item.name: Intent
Returns a list of topics with optional filtering by attributes.

request.name: Returns a list of topics with optional filtering by attributes.

description.content:
This endpoint returns a collection of intent topics, each with detailed information including id, name, theme, and category.

Filtering:
The list of topics can be filtered using query parameters, allowing for dynamic topic retrieval without loading the full list of topics. Each filter is applied independently with OR logic, meaning a topic will be included if it matches any of the specified criteria. Filters accept multiple comma-separated, case-insensitive values, providing flexibility for broad and inclusive searches.

query.description: Filters results by topic IDs. Accepts a comma-separated list of IDs, returning topics that match any of the specified IDs.
Filters results by topic name. Accepts a comma-separated list of strings, returning topics where the name contains any of the specified strings (case-insensitive).
Filters results by topic theme. Accepts a comma-separated list of strings, returning topics where the theme contains any of the specified strings (case-insensitive).
Filters results by topic category. Accepts a comma-separated list of strings, returning topics where the category contains any of the specified strings (case-insensitive).
Filters results by topic description. Accepts a comma-separated list of strings, returning topics where the description contains any of the specified strings (case-insensitive).

Returns similar topics. Accepts a comma-separated list of IDs, returning topics that are similar to the topics represented by the specified IDs. By default, up to 50 topics are returned. This limit can be modified by the 'maxTopics' parameter.
Modifies the maximum number of topics returned when the 's' query parameter is used.
